query: What promises does VoyageFlow NOT make?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow does not process payments directly [voyageflow-overview::001]. It also does not sell, underwrite, or act as a broker for any travel insurance product, nor does it recommend a specific insurer, plan, or coverage amount [travel-insurance::002]. VoyageFlow cannot provide advice on whether a given policy is adequate for a traveler's situation or process claims, refunds, or reimbursements of any kind [travel-insurance::002]. Furthermore, VoyageFlow cannot guarantee hotel availability or prices, flight availability or fares, cancellation or refund outcomes, visa approvals, entry permissions, or health clearances [booking-policies::002]. Real-time seat availability is not stored inside VoyageFlow [voyageflow-overview::002]. VoyageFlow does not act as a travel agent, an Online Travel Agency (OTA), or a merchant of record [voyageflow-overview::002].
